usedFor: Flow tracks the tasks, and Razorpay creates a payment request through “Create Payment Link” when “Task Completed” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Completed” in Flow, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: Finishing a piece of work produces a link the client can pay, with the amount set in the template.

watchOut: “Task Completed” in Flow is polling, so “Create Payment Link” follows a scheduled check rather than the click.
